newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: PARLIAMENT GUARANTEES 240 MLN LITAS CREDITS.
newsitem.headline: PARLIAMENT GUARANTEES 240 MLN LITAS CREDITS.

text.p: The Lithuanian parliament decided on Monday evening to issue a state guarantee of 240 million litas to the Agricultural Bank and Vilniaus Bank for credits to grain processing companies.
A 160 million litas state guarantee was issued to Agricultural Bank and 80 million litas to Vilniaus Bank, the parliament's press office said.
It also said that the credits could be issued for up to nine months and the interest rate for the credits should not exceed 12 percent.
The credits will be used to buy the 344,000 tonne 1997 grain quota from the country's farmers and agricultural cooperatives.
